console_api.h

Register commands with the interactive command-line interface (CLI), inspect the registered command table, dispatch command lines, and run the prompt loop.

cmd_func_t
typedef void (
*
cmd_func_t
)(const char *args)

Handler signature for dynamically registered CLI commands.

Parameters
args

Text following the command name. The string may be empty.

cli_cmd_t

One dynamically registered command.

Fields
name

NUL-terminated command name matched by the dispatcher.

func

Handler invoked with the text following the command name.

cli_register_command
int cli_register_command(
const 
char 
*
name,
cmd_func_t 
func
)

Registers a dynamic CLI command, or updates the handler when the name is already registered.

Parameters
name
const char*

Command name shown and matched by the CLI.

func
cmd_func_t

Handler called when the command is dispatched.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL when name or func is NULL; -ENOSPC when the dynamic command table is full.

cli_get_command_count
int cli_get_command_count(
void
)

Return the number of dynamically registered CLI commands.

Returns

The current number of registered dynamic commands, from 0 through CLI_MAX_DYNAMIC_CMDS.

cli_get_command
const cli_cmd_t *cli_get_command(
int 
index
)

Returns a read-only entry from the dynamic command table.

Parameters
index
int

Zero-based dynamic-command index.

Returns

A pointer to the registered command, or NULL when index is out of range.
